title: Roll out retention controls to production with a DPO-reviewed first purge
description: Deploy tasks 2-4 to prod after qa sign-off, following sdlc/policy.json releaseProcess (dev -> qa -> prod, 1 approval, rollback plan) and any changeFreeze in applications/db-models/env/*.json. Take an encrypted mongodump of the user and secrets collections first. Backfill secrets.expires_at, create the TTL index, run purge_expired in report-only mode, and have the DPO review the counts. Only then enable erasure. Record the retention period per collection so refresh-metastore can capture it in sdlc/metastore.json.
acceptanceCriteria: In prod, db.secrets.getIndexes() lists expires_at_1 with expireAfterSeconds 0 and db.secrets.countDocuments({expires_at: {$exists: false}}) returns 0
A report-only purge log with counts, and a DPO approval to enable erasure, both exist and are dated before the first erasing run
The first erasing prod run log shows counts matching the report-only run, within the users that changed state between the two runs

verificationMethod.description: The CISO reviews the prod deploy record, the pre-deploy backup reference, the getIndexes output, the report-only and first erasing purge logs, and the DPO approval. Expected: all artefacts exist, counts reconcile, and no PII appears in the logs.

rootCause.description: Retention was never enforced in production, so the new controls must be introduced carefully against years of accumulated PII and credentials without erasing records still under statutory retention.
